classification.difficultyReason: Use the formula supplied for each missing column; the hardest row requires finding an elapsed interval across an hour boundary, converting minutes to hours, then calculating speed.

answer.worked:
From 10:30 am to 2:30 pm is $4$ hours.
$$\begin{align*}d&=st\\d&=62\times4\\d&=248\text{ km}\end{align*}$$

From 07:52 to 8:22 is $30$ minutes, or $0.5$ hours.
$$\begin{align*}s&=\frac{d}{t}\\s&=\frac{26}{0.5}\\s&=52\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}t&=\frac{d}{s}\\t&=\frac{10}{18}\\t&=\frac59\text{ h}\\t&=0.\dot5\text{ h}\\t&=33\text{ min }20\text{ s}\end{align*}$$
The calculator's sexagesimal conversion gives $0$ hours $33$ minutes $20$ seconds.
